title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still cannot gain access.

title: Payment Failed - Card Declined
description: Customer attempted to pay using Visa ending 1234 but the payment keeps failing despite sufficient balance in the account.

title: Unable to Download Invoice
description: Customer cannot download their January invoice from the billing section. The download button is unresponsive on Chrome.

title: Incorrect Billing Address
description: Customer's billing address shows a different city. They updated it in profile but it still displays the old one on checkout.

title: App Crash on Launch
description: Customer reports that the mobile app crashes immediately upon opening on Android 13 devices. Needs urgent fix.

title: Refund Not Processed
description: Customer requested a refund two weeks ago for order #8821 but has not received the amount in their bank yet.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Issue
description: Customer is not receiving 2FA codes on their registered phone number via SMS. Email 2FA is working though.

title: Unable to Update Profile Picture
description: Customer tries to upload a new profile picture (JPG, 2MB) but gets an 'Upload failed' server error every time.

title: Subscription Auto-Renewal
description: Customer wants to enable auto-renewal for their premium subscription but the toggle is disabled in the settings dashboard.

title: Missing Order Confirmation Email
description: Customer placed an order but didn't receive a confirmation email even though the payment was successfully processed.

title: API Key Integration Error
description: Developer customer reporting '401 Unauthorized' error even with a valid production API key. Integration is blocked.

title: Search Filter Not Working
description: The date range filter in the transaction history page is not returning any results for the year 2023.

title: Spelling Mistake in UI
description: There is a typo in the 'Cencel Subscription' button. It should be spelled as 'Cancel'. Found on the billing page.

title: Export to CSV Failing
description: When trying to export large reports (5000+ rows) to CSV, the system timed out with a 504 Gateway error.

title: Bulk Notification Issue
description: Internal team reporting that bulk push notifications are only reaching 20% of the target user base.
